question: Where does the prospectively validated resid10 causal signal gain its remaining strength in native blocks10-17, and does an exact carried/attention/MLP factorial confirm the largest selection-half increment on disjoint confirmation rows?
data_status: All direct-query resid10-18 suffix-curve outcomes are unopened. All block10-17 carried/attention/MLP factorial outcomes are unopened. Earlier endpoint measurements do not reveal which suffix block has the largest increment.

population_split.source: The 32 A1/A2 rows in immutable builder order.
population_split.selection: First 16 rows, balanced 8 A1/8 A2 and 4 per family-direction cell.
population_split.confirmation: Last 16 rows, balanced 8 A1/8 A2 and 4 per family-direction cell.
population_split.selection_rule: On selection rows only, choose the lowest block number maximizing mean recovery(residN+1)-mean recovery(residN), N in 10..17.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_and_exact_in: All hashes/terminals, split hashes/balance, native capability, native/manual, writer tensor, selected-boundary tensor, and full-factor/direct-ceiling closures pass fixed checks.
predictions.pred_b_writer_and_endpoint_recurrence: Selection and confirmation writer means are positive with at least 0.75 direction per family; selection resid18 reproduces its writer within 1e-4 scored logit and recovery; pooled writer remains within 0.01 of 0.2835613798.
predictions.pred_c_suffix_gain_and_selection: Selection resid18 exceeds resid10 by at least 0.04, all endpoint family directions are at least 0.75, and the frozen rule selects one block with increment at least 0.007.
predictions.pred_d_disjoint_factorial_confirmation: On confirmation rows, the selected boundary's attention+MLP Shapley sum is positive, full recovery exceeds carried-only recovery, and at least one new factor has positive full-arm removal damage in both A1 and A2.
predictions.pred_e_exact_coverage: The selection curve and writer plus confirmation factorial/direct ceiling and writer produce exactly 320 finite records within 52 forwards and 480 example evaluations, with no fits, backwards, or updates.

terminal.screen: A-E pass: promote the selected suffix crossing as disjointly confirmed and compile it into the next program boundary.
terminal.null: The run is valid and endpoints recur, but suffix-gain selection or disjoint component confirmation fails.
terminal.invalid: Authority, split, capability, alignment, instrument, endpoint recurrence, finiteness, coverage, or price fails.

efficiency: One model load shares full suffix captures; an immutable 16/16 split permits adaptive localization and confirmatory factorization in one GPU job without selection leakage.
novelty: First leakage-controlled localization and disjoint exact confirmation inside the native blocks10-17 suffix of the aspectual causal program.
